title: PV export
summary: The same two devices, with the string now permitted to export. Reversing the grid changes its kind rather than its sign: it stops being a source and becomes a sink, which is all it takes to switch on the export channel and its compensation.
decides: An exporting grid is a sink, not a source with a negative reading.
Export compensation is earned by the sources the export was drawn from.
The applicable self-consumption ratio measures only what stayed home.
Zero gross power guards to zero rather than dividing by zero.

states.note: The string outruns the house; the surplus leaves through the grid.
Everything the string makes is exported: the home base load is exactly zero.
The grid exports while nothing is producing — an impossible meter set that must not divide by zero.
